author: Nerdstalgic
description:
The Prince of Egypt was supposed to be a giant leap forward in the medium of animation.  Pushing away from Disney's family friendly tone and musical numbers, The Prince of Egypt was made with an older audience in mind while also pushing the boundaries of what we thought an animated feature film could look like. 

Full Video: https://youtu.be/f9viECfnTI0
